Status check first: read `lib/games.ts` at /opt/nxeon-staging to get the CURRENT full game family list — after today's work the catalog should be around 32 orderable games (an original ~20, plus Dragonwilds/Sunkenland/Abiotic Factor/Core Keeper/Icarus, plus ARK: Survival Ascended/Soulmask/Don't Starve Together/Vintage Story/Necesse/TF2/Left 4 Dead 2). Confirm the exact current count and list.

Already researched and explicitly ruled OUT this session (do not re-suggest): Pax Dei, Dune Awakening (official-shard-only), World of Warcraft private servers (active 2026 Blizzard litigation, high legal risk), PUBG (no real public dedicated-server path exists), Grounded/Grounded 2 (no official dedicated server), Bellwright (weak unofficial scaling). Already known-good but held for a separate cost/product decision, don't re-research: Nightingale, Once Human, Farming Simulator 25.

The owner wants the catalog pushed toward 30-40 total and is asking for MORE candidates beyond everything already covered. Find genuinely good NEW candidates (don't pad with weak ones just to hit a number) using the same bar as before:
1. Real, official (or at minimum broadly legitimate/standard) dedicated server support — actual SteamCMD app or official server binary, not P2P/shard-only.
2. Real current player demand.
3. A beatable ("host-owned") hosting SERP — check "[game] server hosting"/"[game] dedicated server" search results; skip anything dominated by mega-authority sites.
4. No GPU dependency (hard constraint).
5. No legally murky reverse-engineered/emulator situation (that's a separate, owner-only track — don't recommend anything in that category here).

Cast a genuinely wide net — consider: more recent 2025-2026 survival/co-op breakout titles, other genres with real dedicated-server hosting demand (city builders, colony sims, tower-defense-with-co-op, tycoon games), and any well-established older titles with steady hosting demand not yet in the catalog (check the current list carefully first so you don't suggest duplicates — e.g. is Squad, Insurgency: Sandstorm, Battlefield-adjacent, Killing Floor 2, Barotrauma, Space Engineers, Astroneer, Foundry, or similar already covered or not?).

For each candidate: game name, why it fits (demand + SERP beatability + real dedicated server confirmation), any red flags to exclude on. Aim for a genuinely strong 10-15 candidate list if the bar supports it (quality over padding — if only 6 are truly good, report 6). Under 600 words, ranked, table format.
